The '''Kauron system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Meram sector/Legends|Meram sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kauron]] and [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] in which a [[Cavrilhu Pirates|Cavrilhu Pirate]] [[Cavrilhu's Kauron base|base]] was [[Mission to the Kauron asteroid field|taken out]] by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]].
